t: The Power Port allows you to provide the energy needed to power the Reprocessor.$(br2)Any Forge Energy-compatible cable or generator can be connected to the Power Port.
能量端口允许你为再处理器提供运行所需的能量。$(br2)任何兼容 Forge Energy 的电缆或发电机都可以连接到能量端口。
